messages.subject: Animations in ShinyApps (JavaScript or other)
parts:
I am interested in adding some animations to my ShinyApps page. Is there any support for integrating JavaScript animations or perhaps making graphical animations some other way with ShinyApps? 

Notionally, the ShinyApps UI interface needs to send data to a JavaScript code and it will generate graphics. 

Typical example that I might want to construct with a JavaScript animation is a primitive 1-inch by 1-inch block moving around an x-y space. This animated block in JavaScript (or other that you recommend) would translate and rotate.
